metadata.title: Andy Dalton - Slides to third on depth chart
metadata.description: Dalton is expected to serve as the Eagles' No. 3 quarterback for Sunday's game against the Rams, while Tanner McKee moves up to second on the depth chart as the top backup to Jalen Hurts, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.
metadata.analysis: Dalton had been active ahead of McKee as the No. 2 quarterback for each of the Eagles' first three games of the season, but he didn't see any action until midway through the second quarter of Monday's 27-7 loss to the Bears, when Hurts exited to get checked for a concussion. After three consecutive handoffs to Saquon Barkley got the Eagles to two-yard line to set up a third-and-goal, Dalton proceeded to throw a back-breaking interception in the end zone on his lone pass attempt before Hurts returned for the ensuing possession. The costly pick looks to have been enough to cost Dalton the No. 2 job, at least for one week.

metadata.title: Tanner McKee Named Backup Quarterback, Replacing Andy Dalton
metadata.description: The Philadelphia Eagles have tweaked their quarterback depth chart, naming Tanner McKee the backup over Andy Dalton, according to Mike Garafolo of NFL.com. Dalton had been the No. 2 behind Jalen Hurts through the first three weeks of the season, but he struggled when his number was called last week, throwing an interception on his only pass attempt with Hurts on the sideline. All offseason long, we heard that the competition between McKee and Dalton was incredibly close, so it shouldn't be much of a surprise that the Eagles are pivoting to McKee after Dalton's miscue. The change takes effect for Week 4, with Dalton now inactive as the emergency third-string quarterback. Of course, the Eagles hope they don't have to play either quarterback, as that would mean Jalen Hurts is injured. For now, Hurts is healthy, leaving both McKee and Dalton on the sideline.

metadata.title: Andy Dalton - Active as backup signal-caller
metadata.description: Dalton is active as the Eagles' top backup quarterback for Sunday's game against the Titans.
metadata.analysis: After facing competition from Tanner McKee and rookie Cole Payton for the No. 2 job behind Jalen Hurts throughout training camp and the preseason, Dalton has emerged as the victor in the job battle. Dalton will suit up for the second week in a row, while McKee is inactive as the emergency No. 3 quarterback and Payton is also donning street clothes.

metadata.title: Andy Dalton - Impressive in final exhibition
metadata.description: Dalton completed 12 of 19 passes for 104 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions in the Eagles' 30-13 preseason loss to the Bengals on Friday.
metadata.analysis: Dalton took over for Tanner McKee to open the second half and got plenty of work, with the highlight of his night a five-yard touchdown pass to Carson Steele late in the third quarter. Dalton finished the preseason having completed 18 of 35 passes for 168 yards with Friday's touchdown, and his performance against the Bengals may have been sufficient to garner him the No. 2 job to open the season.

metadata.title: Andy Dalton Leading Eagles QB2 Battle
metadata.description: Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Andy Dalton "still appears to be the leader" in the team's backup quarterback battle, according to Zach Berman of The Athletic. Dalton had a rough showing in the Eagles' first preseason game against the Baltimore Ravens last Saturday, but Berman writes that the veteran "showed improvement" during the team's joint practice session with the New England Patriots on Wednesday. Dalton's competition for the QB2 role behind Jalen Hurts in Philadelphia is Tanner McKee, who has played in six games (two starts) since being picked by the Eagles in the sixth round of the 2023 Draft. Dalton obviously has significantly more NFL experience, as he's logged 169 career starts across 15 seasons. As long as Hurts stays healthy, neither Dalton nor McKee will play a fantasy-relevant role. Still, fantasy managers in deeper, two-quarterback formats looking for the handcuff option to Hurts may want to target Dalton.

metadata.title: Andy Dalton - Draws start in preseason opener
metadata.description: Dalton started Saturday's 24-7 preseason loss to the Ravens and completed three of six passes for 20 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions.
metadata.analysis: The veteran backup found out earlier in the week he'd get the starting call to open the Eagles' preseason schedule, per Jeff Neiburg of The Philadelphia Inquirer, but it could be Tanner McKee who opens Philadelphia's second preseason contest. Dalton played on the first three possessions before giving way to McKee, yet neither quarterback did anything to distinguish themselves on a sluggish night for Philadelphia's offense. Dalton's next opportunity to make a case for the No. 2 job comes next Saturday night on the road against the Patriots.

metadata.title: Andy Dalton sees second-team reps Thursday
metadata.description: Andy Dalton took second-team reps with the Eagles on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Dalton will continue to rotate second-team reps with Tanner McKee throughout training camp as they compete for the backup job.

metadata.title: Andy Dalton, Tanner McKee Will Continue to Rotate at QB2
metadata.description: Philadelphia Eagles head coach Nick Sirianni said on Wednesday that the team will continue to rotate at QB2 with veteran Andy Dalton and Tanner McKee like they did during the spring, per Dave Zangaro of NBC Sports. The Eagles acquired Dalton in a trade from the Carolina Panthers back in March. The 38-year-old veteran will bring plenty of experience to the QB room behind starter Jalen Hurts as the Eagles look to rebound from a particularly frustrating offensive year in 2025. The former second-round pick by the Cincinnati Bengals in 2011 from TCU has 15 years of experience in the NFL, but he's only started seven games in the last three years with the Panthers. In four appearances (one start) in 2025, Dalton threw for 293 yards, one touchdown and an interception. If Dalton ends up winning the QB2 job outright in Philly during camp and the preseason, the Eagles could look to trade McKee to a QB-needy team right before the start of the 2026 regular season.

metadata.title: Andy Dalton continues to work as Eagles QB2 in practice
metadata.description: Andy Dalton was the QB2 for a third straight open practice on Tuesday.
metadata.analysis: Dalton continues to appear to have the edge over Tanner McKee to backup Jalen Hurts.

metadata.title: Andy Dalton continues to receive second-team reps Tuesday
metadata.description: Andy Dalton took reps with the second-team in practice at Eagles OTAs on Tuesday.
metadata.analysis: Dalton continues to appear to hold the edge over Tanner McKee to backup Jalen Hurts.

metadata.title: Andy Dalton takes snaps ahead of Tanner McKee in practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Andy Dalton was the second-team quarterback ahead of Tanner McKee in practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Dalton and McKee figure to battle the next few months for the backup role behind Jalen Hurts. This will remain a training camp battle to monitor.

metadata.title: Andy Dalton traded to Eagles
metadata.description: Former Panthers QB Andy Dalton is being traded to the Eagles.
metadata.analysis: Philadelphia sends a seventh-round pick in exchange for the veteran quarterback. Dalton and Tanner McKee will operate behind Jalen Hurts, while Kenny Pickett serves as the backup to Bryce Young.
